_doc: MISUMI HFS8-4545: a 45 x 45 mm aluminium extrusion of its 8-45 series, clear anodised (HFSB8-4545 is the same section in black). Dimensions, area, second moments and mass are from MISUMI's catalogue page. The drawn outline leaves out the four lobes round the bore, the V marks on the core and the hollows' rounded corners. MISUMI prints no section modulus or torsion constant.

twist_per_metre.rule: Twist: 1/2 degree or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 38 to 76 mm (63.6 mm here), at most 5 degrees over the whole length. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
